get.description: Returns the list of Budget Change Histories for a given project

schema.description: Request body for fetching change histories with filtering options. All filters within a single filter object are combined with OR condition.

filters.description: A collection of named filters to apply to the change history query. Currently only supports the `segments` filter.

segments.description: An array of segment filter objects. Each object specifies the segment ID, the tier (if applicable), and the array of segment-option IDs to filter by.

tier.description: The tier for the segment (if applicable). Set to `null` if not used.

values.description: An array of segment-option IDs for the given segment/tier.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

budget_code.description: The Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code of the affected budget line, made up of its segment values concatenated by the company's configured delimiter. Identifies which budget line the change applies to.

description.description: Human-readable description of the budget code (the WBS line item name).

type.description: Localized label describing which budget entity was changed (for example a budget line item, a forecast value, or a specific column).

column.description: Localized name of the budget column whose value changed.

created_at.description: When the change was recorded, returned as a localized, human-readable display string (not ISO 8601). Format depends on the project's locale and timezone.

created_by.description: Display name of the user who made the change, formatted for the company.

new_value.description: The column's value after the change, formatted for display (currency, percentage, number, or option label depending on the column).

old_value.description: The column's value before the change, formatted for display (currency, percentage, number, or option label depending on the column).

reason_code.description: A machine-readable code that identifies the error specifically enough for the client to interpret what happened and take action.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"filters\":{\"segments\":[{\"id\":\"18911\",\"tier\":\"1\",\"values\":[\"2\"]}]}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/budget_change_history?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
